name: durable-layer-node-set
body: The authored rows a scan assembles from the durable layer tree `apg/layers/**` (Stakeholder/User/Requirement/DomainGroup/Entity/Value/Service/System/Container/Component/Person/Constraint/Note and their spine edges) together with the transient rows from `.trans/plans/**` (Plan/PlanPhase/Task/Feedback and their rels). A full rebuild writes them into `db.lbug`; the splice writes none of them. This set is the half of the assembled graph the splice assumes the seed already holds.
